import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = scanner.nextLong();
        long sum = 0;
        for (long i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            long y = scanner.nextLong();
            sum += y;
        }
        System.out.println(sum / n);
    }
}
